name: Sapindus

project_scope.selection_mode: canonical S. drummondii + B160 strict reconciliation
project_scope.note: Western soapberry remains canonical Sapindus drummondii. Older var./subsp. drummondii names and the typographic duplicate map to that learner. B160 independently reviewed Sapindus saponaria sensu stricto: it is an accepted species, but current Kew/POWO and USDA GRIN native-range treatments exclude Texas, so the Hays source cannot support it as a target-zone native.

study_strategy.warning: Historical Texas sources often use Sapindus saponaria broadly for western soapberry. Under the current project treatment, verify whether an old record is var./subsp. drummondii before assigning it: western-soapberry records map to S. drummondii, while S. saponaria s.s. is not treated as Texas-native.

quick_comparison: S. drummondii — canonical western soapberry; older S. saponaria var./subsp. drummondii names map here. B160 target-zone support: Hays, Travis, Kerr.

S. saponaria s.s. — distinct accepted tropical/subtropical species; current Kew/POWO and USDA GRIN native-range treatments do not include Texas. Do not use old Texas 'S. saponaria' labels as evidence for s.s.
